# API reference

Use the API on the same origin as your Compallm application. Paths below include the `/api` prefix. In examples, replace `https://compallm.example` with your deployment's origin.

## Authentication

Check each operation's authentication section before calling it. Public operations do not require a user credential. Verification challenges are only for email confirmation, not access to protected resources.

## Requests and errors

Send the content type specified by the operation. Use the HTTP response status to distinguish success from failure; response schemas and recovery guidance are documented per status. JSON error responses, when declared, contain a human-readable `message`.

Examples contain synthetic values. Replace challenges and credentials with values obtained from your own requests; do not publish real credentials.

## Operations

- [POST /api/auth/signup/email](auth/signup/email/post.md) — Request an email signup code.
- [POST /api/auth/signup/email/confirmation/otp](auth/signup/email/confirmation/otp/post.md) — Confirm email signup with a verification code.
